topic: The apartment where 11 tenants vanished — all on the same day of the month
hook: 11 tenants vanished from this apartment. Always the same day.
script: 11 tenants vanished from this apartment. Always the same day. In the 1940s, the Leyendecker building in Germany recorded 11 missing persons cases across two decades. Each disappearance occurred on the 17th of the month. No bodies were recovered. Police investigations found no connection between the tenants. The building was eventually demolished. The land beneath it remains undeveloped. Local authorities have never offered an official explanation. Follow for real unsolved disappearance cases.
